description: This Java class 'DefinitionManager' provides a GUI for managing ECU definition files, allowing users to add, remove, reorder, and save configuration files related to ECU definitions within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: DefinitionManager
classes.description: A JFrame-based GUI for managing ECU definition files, including functionalities to add, remove, move, save, and undo changes to the list of definition files.

methods.name: DefinitionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI components, setting icon, and loading initial settings.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Loads ECU definition files from settings and populates the list.

methods.name: initComponents
methods.description: Auto-generated method setting up GUI components and layout.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles button click events for add, remove, move, save, cancel, undo, and apply actions.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves the current list of ECU definition files to settings.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Opens a file chooser dialog to add a new ECU definition file.

methods.name: moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the selected file up or down in the list based on direction.

methods.name: removeSelection
methods.description: Removes the selected file from the list.

methods.name: updateListModel
methods.description: Refreshes the GUI list to reflect current fileNames.
